MI_DEBUG_TSAN:BOOL=OFF

//Build with undefined-behavior sanitizer (needs clang++)
MI_DEBUG_UBSAN:BOOL=OFF

//Extra pre-processor definitions (use as `-DMI_EXTRA_CPPDEFS="opt1=val1;opt2=val2"`)
MI_EXTRA_CPPDEFS:BOOL=OFF

//Build with guard pages behind certain object allocations (implies
// MI_NO_PADDING=ON)
MI_GUARDED:BOOL=OFF

//Install directly into $CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX instead of PREFIX/lib/mimalloc-version
MI_INSTALL_TOPLEVEL:BOOL=OFF

//Enable this when linking with musl libc
MI_LIBC_MUSL:BOOL=OFF

//Use local-dynamic-tls, a slightly slower but dlopen-compatible
// thread local storage mechanism (Unix)
MI_LOCAL_DYNAMIC_TLS:BOOL=OFF

//Do not use architecture specific optimizations (like '-march=armv8.1-a'
// for example) (has priority over MI_OPT_ARCH)
MI_NO_OPT_ARCH:BOOL=OFF

//Force no use of padding even in DEBUG mode etc.
MI_NO_PADDING:BOOL=OFF

//Disable transparent huge pages support on Linux/Android for the
// mimalloc process only
MI_NO_THP:BOOL=OFF

//Use plain C compilation (has priority over MI_USE_CXX)
MI_NO_USE_CXX:BOOL=OFF

//Only for optimized builds: turn on architecture specific optimizations
// (for x64: '-march=haswell;-mavx2' (2013), for arm64: '-march=armv8.1-a'
// (2016))
MI_OPT_ARCH:BOOL=OFF

//Use SIMD instructions (requires MI_OPT_ARCH to be enabled)
MI_OPT_SIMD:BOOL=OFF

//Use interpose to override standard malloc on macOS
MI_OSX_INTERPOSE:BOOL=OFF

//Use malloc zone to override standard malloc on macOS
MI_OSX_ZONE:BOOL=ON

//Override the standard malloc interface (i.e. define entry points
// for 'malloc', 'free', etc)
MI_OVERRIDE:BOOL=OFF

//Enable padding to detect heap block overflow (always on in DEBUG
// or SECURE mode, or with Valgrind/ASAN)
MI_PADDING:BOOL=OFF

//Use full security mitigations (like guard pages, allocation randomization,
// double-free mitigation, and free-list corruption detection)
MI_SECURE:BOOL=OFF

//Generate assembly files
MI_SEE_ASM:BOOL=OFF

//Show error and warning messages by default (only enabled by default
// in DEBUG mode)
MI_SHOW_ERRORS:BOOL=OFF

//Skip collecting memory on program exit
MI_SKIP_COLLECT_ON_EXIT:BOOL=OFF

//Compile with address sanitizer support (adds a small overhead)
MI_TRACK_ASAN:BOOL=OFF

//Compile with Windows event tracing (ETW) support (adds a small
// overhead)
MI_TRACK_ETW:BOOL=OFF

//Compile with Valgrind support (adds a small overhead)
MI_TRACK_VALGRIND:BOOL=OFF

//Use the C++ compiler to compile the library (instead of the C
// compiler)
MI_USE_CXX:BOOL=OFF

//Explicitly link with -latomic (on older systems) (deprecated
// and detected automatically)
MI_USE_LIBATOMIC:BOOL=OFF

//Use only direct TLS slots on Windows to avoid extra tests in
// the malloc fast path (only works if the program uses less than
// 64 TlsAlloc'd slots in total)
MI_WIN_DIRECT_TLS:BOOL=OFF

//Use redirection module ('mimalloc-redirect') on Windows if compiling
// mimalloc as a DLL
MI_WIN_REDIRECT:BOOL=ON

//Use Fiber local storage on Windows to detect thread termination
// (deprecated)
MI_WIN_USE_FLS:BOOL=OFF

//Enable abort() call on memory allocation failure by default
MI_XMALLOC:BOOL=OFF

//Path to a program.
PERL_EXECUTABLE:FILEPATH=/usr/bin/perl

//choose which WebKit port to build (one of GTK;IOS;JSCOnly;Mac;PlayStation;WPE;Win)
PORT:STRING=JSCOnly

//Path to the Python interpreter
PYTHON_EXECUTABLE:FILEPATH=/usr/bin/python3

//generate an installation rule to install the built JavaScript
// shell
SHOULD_INSTALL_JS_SHELL:BOOL=OFF

//Path to unifdef executable
UNIFDEF_EXECUTABLE:FILEPATH=/build/bin/unifdef

//Support 64 KB userspace page size (reduces security and performance)
USE_64KB_PAGE_BLOCK:BOOL=OFF

USE_AVIF:BOOL=ON

//Enable lightweight run-time assertions in the C++ standard library
USE_CXX_STDLIB_ASSERTIONS:BOOL=ON

//Collapse per-target include directories into a Clang header map
USE_HEADER_MAPS:BOOL=OFF

//Toggle IsoMalloc support
USE_ISO_MALLOC:BOOL=ON

//Toggle support for JPEG XL images
USE_JPEGXL:BOOL=ON

//Toggle support for image color management using libcms2

//Whether to enable usage of libbacktrace.

//Toggle mimalloc instead of WebKit's custom allocator

//Use PGO profile data for optimization (set PGO_PROFILE_PATH)

//Whether to use Skia instead of Cairo.
